name: TypeNotes
description: A fun, work in progress project to turn typed class notes into clean, organized PDFs with page by page editing, customizable themes, and easy sharing.

paragraphs: Type your class notes page by page, turn them into a clean PDF, then download and share it. Made for anyone whose handwriting makes sharing notes hard.

🚧 Status: under development. This is a fun, work-in-progress AI-assisted project, made to give one of my ideas a shape. Things may change, break, or be improved at any time. Feedback and ideas are welcome!
features: Simple formatting: headings, bullets, numbered lists, bold, italic, highlight, important boxes
Page-by-page notebook: leave a page unfinished, write other pages, and come back to finish it later
Live preview of the page you are writing, and one-click PDF download (all pages)
4 themes: Clean Blue, Warm Orange, Forest Green, Ruled Paper
Notebook: save notes by subject, reopen them, search all notes
